groups.activity: complete The Second Dream, then Octavia's Anthem

rows.label: Mandachord
rows.note: quest reward; needed for final build

conditions: The Second Dream is the actual quest gate; The War Within is not required for Octavia's Anthem.
The Mandachord has a 10-second Foundry build when needed for the final blueprint.
bonuses: The quest is replayable if you want to revisit its music-puzzle missions.

groups.activity: choose Octavia during her weekly offering
groups.meta: Octavia is week 9 of the 11-week rotation
conditions: Circuit rewards are guaranteed by completed-stage progress, not RNG drops; tiers reset weekly.
The tier-2 Neuroptics is the major shortcut. Take it during Octavia's week instead of committing to repeated 20-minute Survival runs.
Progress is banked per completed stage; failing or aborting a stage loses that stage's progress.
bonuses: Completing four stages earns the daily +50 Circuit Progress bonus, making shorter sessions efficient.
If Octavia is live, claim the low tiers first; the full tier-10 route takes substantially longer than obtaining the quest blueprint.

disclosures.title: best use of the Circuit
disclosures.body: Neuroptics at tier 2 is the payoff. The traditional version is a 22.56% Rotation C reward with one roll every 20 minutes; Circuit turns that worst part into four completed stages.

conditions: Open at least one cache to make the Systems reward roll. Finding all three completes the cache reward, not three independent Octavia rolls.
Caches appear on loot radar and emit an audible hum; use both while learning the tileset.
Plato includes Sentients. Use mixed damage, or Operator Void Beam, to reset their damage adaptation.
bonuses: Crossfire Exterminate is quick, so farm Systems in the same Lua session as music-room Capture reloads.

groups.activity: find the Lua Music Puzzle room and solve its note sequence

rows.label: Octavia Chassis Blueprint
rows.note: top crate on the central structure

conditions: The Chassis is guaranteed; the RNG is the Conservatory room spawning. Capture is preferred for short, wide tiles and fast restarts.
Use the room with glowing blue pressure plates around a central pillar, not the Agility Test's giant organ.
After completing the fixed memory sequence, bullet-jump to the upper crate. The lower crate near the console can contain a built Forma.
bonuses: Titania, Wukong, or Zephyr make room checks and the jump to the upper crate easier.
If you enter the wrong room, leave and reload rather than spending time on the Agility Test.

groups.mode: extract only after a C reward

rows.label: Octavia Neuroptics Blueprint
rows.note: Rotation C at 20:00, then every 20 min

conditions: Survival uses A-A-B-C rotations at 5-minute intervals. A and B rewards at 5, 10, and 15 minutes cannot drop the Neuroptics.
Do not follow a public squad extracting before 20:00: that run never reaches an eligible reward roll.
Terrorem is Infested with no armor; Heat/Slash and melee work well. Toxic Ancients make health-tank or invisibility frames safer than shield-only builds.
bonuses: Run this only if Circuit is unavailable or you specifically prefer the immediate RNG route.

disclosures.title: the traditional wall
disclosures.body: Each C rotation is one 22.56% attempt, so four 20-minute runs is the average, but bad-luck streaks can be much longer. Circuit is the recommended escape hatch.

rows.label: Neuroptics
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 1,000 Oxium, 4,800 Polymer Bundle, 2,600 Plastids, 5 Neural Sensors

rows.label: Chassis
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 6,000 Polymer Bundle, 25,000 Salvage, 1,500 Plastids, 3 Neurodes

rows.label: Systems
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 2,000 Kuva, 3,000 Circuits, 20 Morphics, 5 Orokin Cell

conditions: Start all three component builds in parallel before starting Octavia's final build.
bonuses: Farm Kuva and Orokin Cells before the components complete so Systems does not become the final delay.
